baseline.scope_en: Every space POI the installed worldgen data can generate, with the outputs, capacity and cargo requirements declared by the game assembly.
baseline.scope_zh: 列出已安裝世界生成資料可能生成的所有太空興趣點，並附上遊戲組件宣告的產出、容量與貨艙需求。
baseline.coordinatePolicy_en: Exact starmap coordinates are rolled per world seed and are not listed. Only the ring range each cluster allows is shown, which is the same for every player of that cluster.
baseline.coordinatePolicy_zh: 確切星圖座標由世界種子決定，本站不列出；只顯示各星團允許的環距範圍，該範圍對所有玩同一星團的玩家都相同。

mechanics.summary_en: Harvesting a space POI requires a rocket with a Drillcone, Diamond for the drill, and a cargo bay matching each output phase.
mechanics.summary_zh: 採集太空興趣點需要配備鑽頭前錐的火箭、供鑽頭消耗的鑽石，以及對應各產出相態的貨艙。
mechanics.recharge_en: Each site rolls its own capacity and refill rate from the ranges below when the world is generated, so two players of the same cluster see different totals.
mechanics.recharge_zh: 每個地點在世界生成時會在下列範圍內各自決定容量與回充率，因此同一星團的兩位玩家看到的數值並不相同。

pois.desc_en:
The harvestable remains of a planet containing Nickel Ore, Peat, Amber, and Shale.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一顆星球的可開採殘骸，內含鎳礦石、泥炭、琥珀和頁岩。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Renewable solid fuel produced by Lumbs from suitable plant food. It can supplement coal power, but ranch space and feed supply determine true output.
outputs.use_zh: 可由隆布食用適當植物食物後再生的固體燃料，可補充煤電；實際產量受牧場空間與飼料供應限制。

outputs.use_en: Refine into nickel for specialized construction and alloy chains introduced with Prehistoric content. Keep a strategic stock instead of using it as generic ore.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成鎳，供史前內容的特殊建築與合金鏈；宜保留戰略庫存，不要當一般礦石消耗。

outputs.use_en: Amber is a Solid organic composite of Resin and Fossil.
outputs.use_zh: 琥珀是一種由樹脂和化石組成的固體有機物。

outputs.use_en: A bulk raw mineral for construction in Prehistoric regions. Prefer it for ordinary structures while conserving metal and specialty thermal materials.
outputs.use_zh: 史前地區的大量建築原礦；一般結構優先使用頁岩，可節省金屬與特殊熱材。

strategic_en: Renewable Peat for early power and Amber for Prehistoric research, plus Nickel Ore for Nickel refining.
strategic_zh: 可再生的泥炭供前期發電、琥珀供史前研究，另有鎳礦可精煉為鎳。
attention_en: Peat burns as fuel but also decomposes; plan storage temperature before stockpiling large amounts.
attention_zh: 泥炭可作燃料但也會分解；大量囤積前先規劃儲存溫度。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid containing Refined Carbon and Coal.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有精製炭與煤炭的小行星。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
outputs.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

outputs.use_en: (C) Refined carbon is solid element purified from raw Coal.
outputs.use_zh: (C) 精製炭是由未加工的煤炭精製而成的固體元素。

strategic_en: A renewable Refined Carbon supply that skips the Kiln, useful for Steel production once Iron and Lime are handled elsewhere.
strategic_zh: 可再生的精煉碳來源，免去窯爐工序；在鐵與石灰另有來源時有助於鋼的生產。
attention_en: Pure solid field: one solid cargo bay is enough.
attention_zh: 純固體礦場：一個固體貨艙即可。

pois.desc_en:
A cloud of harvestable debris containing Chlorine Gas and Bleach Stone.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有氯氣與漂白石的可收穫碎屑雲。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
outputs.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

outputs.use_en: A cryogenic chlorine phase used mainly for storage or thermal designs before warming back into chlorine gas. It is extremely cold and phase changes can break pipes.
outputs.use_zh: 氯的低溫液相，主要用於儲存或熱力設計，升溫後會成氯氣。溫度極低，發生相變時可能損壞管線。

strategic_en: Renewable Bleach Stone for Chlorine sterilization loops and Oxygen Diffuser deodorizing without consuming a planet-side deposit.
strategic_zh: 可再生的漂白石，供氯氣消毒與除臭循環使用，不必消耗星球上的礦床。
attention_en: Chlorine arrives as a liquid at its default temperature, so a liquid cargo bay is required alongside the solid bay.
attention_zh: 氯以預設溫度的液態形式取得，因此除固體貨艙外還需液體貨艙。

outputs.use_en: (Ir) Iridium is a firm and highly conductive Metal that can withstand extreme  Heat.
outputs.use_zh: (Ir) 銥是一種堅硬且高導電性的金屬且可以忍受高溫。

strategic_en: The planetary-mixing counterpart of the Prehistoric ore field, and the only renewable Iridium route outside a Prehistoric cluster.
strategic_zh: 史前礦場的行星混搭版本，也是史前星團以外唯一的可再生銥路線。
attention_en: Only generated when Prehistoric Planet Pack planetary mixing is enabled at cluster setup.
attention_zh: 只有在建立星團時啟用史前行星包行星混搭才會生成。

pois.desc_en:
The harvestable remains of a planet containing Hydrogen in gas form, and Methane in solid and liquid form.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
可開採的小行星殘骸，含有氣體形態的氫氣以及固體與液體形態的天然氣。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

outputs.use_en:
(CH4) Methane is an alkane.

This selection is in a Liquid state.
outputs.use_zh:
(CH4) 甲烷是一種烷烴。

處於液體狀態。

outputs.use_en: Fuel for Natural Gas Generators and an input to industrial gas handling. Ventilation and carbon-dioxide byproducts must be planned.
outputs.use_zh: 天然氣發電機的燃料，也可用於工業氣體鏈；需規劃通風及二氧化碳副產物。

outputs.use_en: (CH4) Methane is an alkane in a Solid state.
outputs.use_zh: (CH4) 甲烷是一種烷烴，處於固體狀態。

strategic_en: Renewable Hydrogen for Hydrogen power and liquid-hydrogen rocket fuel, at the highest ratio of any POI.
strategic_zh: 可再生的氫，比例是所有興趣點中最高的，適用於氫氣發電與液氫火箭燃料。
attention_en: Methane arrives in three phases at once; solid, liquid and gas cargo bays are all needed for a full haul.
attention_zh: 甲烷會同時以三種相態產出；要完整帶回需固體、液體與氣體貨艙齊備。

pois.desc_en:
A cloud of planetary remains containing Ice, Carbon Dioxide, Oxygen and Natural Gas.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一團含有冰、二氧化碳、氧氣與天然氣的行星殘骸。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

outputs.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
outputs.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

outputs.use_en: (CH4) Methane is an alkane in a Solid state.
outputs.use_zh: (CH4) 甲烷是一種烷烴，處於固體狀態。

strategic_en: Bulk renewable Ice with Solid Oxygen and Solid Carbon Dioxide alongside it.
strategic_zh: 大量可再生的冰，並附帶固態氧與固態二氧化碳。
attention_en: Oxygen arrives as a gas while the rest is solid; a gas cargo bay is needed to keep it.
attention_zh: 氧以氣態產出，其餘為固態；要保留氧需要氣體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
A field of harvestable resources containing Carbon Dioxide, Igneous Rock and Aluminum Ore.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有二氧化碳、火成岩與鋁礦的可收穫資源區。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
outputs.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

outputs.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

outputs.use_en: Refine into aluminum, an excellent heat-conducting metal for radiant pipes, metal tiles and thermal machinery.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成鋁；鋁導熱優秀，適合輻射管、金屬磚與熱能設備。

strategic_en: Renewable Aluminum Ore for Aluminum refining and heat-conductive building materials.
strategic_zh: 可再生的鋁礦，供鋁精煉與高導熱建材使用。
attention_en: Carbon Dioxide is emitted as a gas and needs a gas cargo bay if you want to keep it.
attention_zh: 二氧化碳以氣態產出；若要保留，需要氣體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
The harvestable remains of a planet containing Cinnabar, Ice and Mercury.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有辰砂、冰和汞的可收穫行星殘骸。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Mercury-bearing ore from cold regions; process it when mercury or its specialized low-temperature material properties are required.
outputs.use_zh: 寒冷地區的含汞礦石；需要汞或其特殊低溫材料性質時再加工。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: (Hg) Mercury is a metallic Liquid.
outputs.use_zh: (Hg) 汞是一種金屬液體。

strategic_en: The planetary-mixing counterpart of the Ceres ore field; the only renewable Cinnabar and Mercury route when the Frosty Planet Pack is mixed into another cluster.
strategic_zh: 穀神星礦場的行星混搭版本；在寒霜行星包混入其他星團時，是硃砂與汞唯一的可再生路線。
attention_en: Only generated when Frosty Planet Pack planetary mixing is enabled at cluster setup.
attention_zh: 只有在建立星團時啟用寒霜行星包行星混搭才會生成。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Cinnabar, Ice and Mercury.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含辰砂、冰和汞的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: Mercury-bearing ore from cold regions; process it when mercury or its specialized low-temperature material properties are required.
outputs.use_zh: 寒冷地區的含汞礦石；需要汞或其特殊低溫材料性質時再加工。

outputs.use_en: (Hg) Mercury is a metallic Liquid.
outputs.use_zh: (Hg) 汞是一種金屬液體。

strategic_en: Renewable Cinnabar and Mercury for Thermium-free cooling loops and Mercury-based temperature transfer.
strategic_zh: 可再生的硃砂與汞，適用於不依賴超導體的冷卻迴路與汞質導熱應用。
attention_en: Mercury is liquid at its default temperature and needs a liquid cargo bay.
attention_zh: 汞在預設溫度下為液態，需要液體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Polluted Ice, Ice, Snow and Aluminum Ore.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含汙冰、冰、雪與鋁礦的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Melts into polluted water, a source of irrigation, coolant and filtered water. It can release germs and should be melted in a controlled basin.
outputs.use_zh: 融化成汙水，可供灌溉、冷卻或過濾成水；可能帶菌，應在受控槽體中融化。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: Refine into aluminum, an excellent heat-conducting metal for radiant pipes, metal tiles and thermal machinery.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成鋁；鋁導熱優秀，適合輻射管、金屬磚與熱能設備。

outputs.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
outputs.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

strategic_en: Bulk renewable Ice and Snow for cooling, plus Aluminum Ore in the same haul.
strategic_zh: 大量可再生的冰與雪供冷卻使用，同一趟還能取得鋁礦。
attention_en: Everything arrives well below freezing; unload into an insulated room or the cargo will chill the base.
attention_zh: 所有產物都遠低於冰點；請卸載到隔熱房間，否則會冷卻基地。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Gold, Fullerene, Regolith and more.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含金、富勒烯 與 表土和其他東西的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
outputs.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

outputs.use_en:
(Au) Gold is a conductive precious Metal.

It is suitable for building Power systems.
outputs.use_zh:
(Au) 金是一種珍貴的導電金屬。

它適合用來建造電力系統。

outputs.use_en: (C60) Fullerene is a form of Coal consisting of spherical molecules.
outputs.use_zh: (C60) 富勒烯是一種完全由碳組成的球狀分子。

outputs.use_en: (C) Refined carbon is solid element purified from raw Coal.
outputs.use_zh: (C) 精製炭是由未加工的煤炭精製而成的固體元素。

outputs.use_en: A falling filtration medium and Shove Vole food found at the surface. It arrives extremely hot and can bury equipment, but also offers heat and filtration opportunities.
outputs.use_zh: 地表常見的落砂型過濾介質，也是尖嗓田鼠飼料。通常非常熱且會掩埋設備，但也可利用其熱量與過濾性。

strategic_en: The renewable Fullerene route, which feeds Super Coolant through the Molecular Forge and Emulsifier.
strategic_zh: 可再生的富勒烯路線，經分子熔爐與乳化機可製成超級冷卻液。
attention_en: Fullerene arrives at -31 °C while the rest of the haul is near room temperature; separate it before storage.
attention_zh: 富勒烯以攝氏 -31 度產出，其餘產物接近常溫；儲存前請分開處理。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Tungsten, Wolframite and more.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含鎢與黑鎢礦和其他東西的小行星礦場。

太空採礦 需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Refine into tungsten for high-temperature builds and Thermium production. It is scarce, so avoid ordinary construction uses.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成鎢，用於高溫建築與導熱質生產；資源稀少，不宜用於一般建築。

outputs.use_en: (W) Molten Tungsten is a crystalline Metal heated into a Liquid state.
outputs.use_zh: (W) 熔融鎢是一種結晶狀的金屬，加熱變成液體狀態。

outputs.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
outputs.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

outputs.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

strategic_en: Renewable Wolframite and Tungsten for high-temperature builds and Thermium production.
strategic_zh: 可再生的黑鎢礦與鎢，適用於高溫建築與超導體生產。
attention_en: Molten Tungsten arrives as a liquid above 3000 °C; without a liquid cargo bay and a heat plan it will destroy the receiving room.
attention_zh: 熔融鎢以超過攝氏 3000 度的液態產出；若沒有液體貨艙與散熱規劃，會摧毀接收區。

pois.desc_en:
A cloud of resources containing Water and Hydrogen Gas.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有水、氫氣。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
outputs.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

outputs.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

strategic_en: Despite the name it yields Water and Hydrogen, making it a renewable water source that needs no Water Sieve.
strategic_zh: 雖然名為氦雲，實際產出為水與氫，是不需淨水器的可再生水源。
attention_en: Both outputs are non-solid; bring liquid and gas cargo bays rather than the usual solid bay.
attention_zh: 兩種產物都非固體；請攜帶液體與氣體貨艙，而非一般的固體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Ice, Carbon Dioxide and Oxygen.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含冰、二氧化碳與氧氣的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: (O2) Solid Oxygen is a breathable element in a Solid state.
outputs.use_zh: (O2) 固態氧是一種可呼吸的元素，處於固體狀態。

strategic_en: Renewable Solid Carbon Dioxide and Solid Oxygen, useful as a cold sink and an emergency oxygen reserve.
strategic_zh: 可再生的固態二氧化碳與固態氧，可作為冷源與緊急氧氣儲備。
attention_en: Solid Oxygen is only 5% of the haul; do not plan life support around this POI alone.
attention_zh: 固態氧只佔產出的 5%；不要只靠此興趣點規劃生命維持。

pois.desc_en:
An interplanetary body that consists of Salt Water, Brine, Salt and Ice.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一個跨星際天體，由鹽水、濃鹽水、鹽與冰所組成。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt; the water can support crops or electrolysis. Freezing separates useful temperature and phase-change opportunities.
outputs.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽；所得水可灌溉或電解製氧。其凝固與融化也能用於溫控與相變處理。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: Used with rust for oxygen, crushed into table salt for morale, and involved in saline processing. Desalinators provide a renewable stream when salt water or brine is renewable.
outputs.use_zh: 可與鐵鏽製氧，也可磨成食鹽提高士氣，並參與鹽水加工；若鹽水或濃鹽水可再生，淡化器能持續產鹽。

outputs.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt and use directly for Waterweed or compatible Aquatic crops. Pumping and desalination add power and heat costs.
outputs.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽，也可直接供水草或相容水族作物；抽水與淡化會增加耗電及熱量。

strategic_en: An even split of Brine, Salt Water, Salt and Ice — a renewable desalination feedstock and Salt source.
strategic_zh: 鹽滷、鹽水、鹽與冰各佔四分之一，是可再生的脫鹽原料與鹽來源。
attention_en: Half the haul is liquid; a liquid cargo bay is mandatory.
attention_zh: 產物有一半是液體；必須攜帶液體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Iron, Copper, Lead, and Obsidian.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含鐵、銅、鉛與黑曜石的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
outputs.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

outputs.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
outputs.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

outputs.use_en: (Pb) Lead is an extremely dense Refined Metal heated into a Liquid state.
outputs.use_zh: (Pb) 鉛是一種被加熱到液體狀態的高密度精煉金屬。

outputs.use_en: (Fe) Molten Iron is a common industrial Metal heated into a Liquid state.
outputs.use_zh: (Fe) 熔融鐵是一種常見的工業金屬，被加熱到液體狀態。

strategic_en: Renewable Iron, Lead and Copper in one destination, covering most refined-metal demand.
strategic_zh: 在同一目的地取得可再生的鐵、鉛與銅，可涵蓋大部分精煉金屬需求。
attention_en: Molten Iron and Molten Lead arrive as very hot liquids; a liquid cargo bay and a cooling plan are required.
attention_zh: 熔融鐵與熔融鉛以高溫液態產出；需要液體貨艙與散熱規劃。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Solid Methane, Carbon Dioxide and Crude Oil.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含固態甲烷、二氧化碳和原油的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

outputs.use_en: Refine into petroleum for power, plastic and rockets, or boil it for higher-yield petroleum. Oil systems produce heat and carbon-heavy byproducts.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成石油，用於發電、塑膠與火箭；亦可加熱裂解以提高產率。原油系統會產生熱與含碳副產物。

outputs.use_en: (CH4) Methane is an alkane in a Solid state.
outputs.use_zh: (CH4) 甲烷是一種烷烴，處於固體狀態。

strategic_en: A renewable Crude Oil source that needs no Oil Well or Petroleum Boiler pressure management.
strategic_zh: 可再生的原油來源，不需油井或石油鍋爐的壓力管理。
attention_en: Crude Oil is only 11% of the haul; the bulk is Solid Carbon Dioxide that must be disposed of or stored cold.
attention_zh: 原油只佔產出的 11%；大部分為固態二氧化碳，需另行處置或低溫儲存。

pois.desc_en:
A mass of harvestable resources containing Algae, Slime, Polluted Oxygen and Dirt.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有藻類、軟泥、汙氧與泥土的可收穫資源密集區。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭

outputs.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

outputs.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
outputs.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

outputs.use_en: Distill into algae and polluted water, or let it off-gas polluted oxygen. It can contain Slimelung; store submerged and process behind hygiene controls.
outputs.use_zh: 可蒸餾成藻類與汙水，也會逸散汙氧。可能含黏液肺病菌，宜浸液儲存並在衛生管制下加工。

outputs.use_en: Duplicants can breathe it, but it can carry Slimelung and irritants. Deodorize it into clean oxygen and clay, or feed Pufts where disease control is established.
outputs.use_zh: 複製人可呼吸，但可能帶有黏液肺病菌及刺激物。可除臭成氧氣與黏土，或在妥善防疫後供帕夫食用。

strategic_en: Renewable Algae, Slime Mold and Dirt for oxygen and farming, and the most widely placed POI in the game.
strategic_zh: 可再生的藻類、黏菌與泥土，供製氧與農業使用，也是遊戲中配置最廣的興趣點。
attention_en: Contaminated Oxygen and Slime Mold carry Slimelung risk; unload through a disinfected airlock.
attention_zh: 污染氧與黏菌帶有黏菌肺風險；請透過消毒氣閘卸載。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Carbon Dioxide and Rust.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含二氧化碳和鐵鏽的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Feed a Rust Deoxidizer with salt to produce oxygen, chlorine and iron ore. The oxygen chain is finite unless rust is renewed through space or other sources.
outputs.use_zh: 與鹽一起供除鏽機，可產生氧氣、氯氣與鐵礦。除非由太空或其他來源補充，這條製氧鏈屬有限資源。

outputs.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

strategic_en: Bulk renewable Rust for the Rust Deoxidizer, an oxygen route that needs no Algae or water.
strategic_zh: 大量可再生的鏽，供鏽味除氧機使用；這條製氧路線不需藻類或水。
attention_en: The Rust Deoxidizer also consumes Salt; this POI supplies only the Rust half.
attention_zh: 鏽味除氧機同時消耗鹽；此興趣點只提供鏽的部分。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Ice, Polluted Oxygen and Water.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含冰、汙氧與水的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
outputs.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

outputs.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
outputs.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

outputs.use_en: Duplicants can breathe it, but it can carry Slimelung and irritants. Deodorize it into clean oxygen and clay, or feed Pufts where disease control is established.
outputs.use_zh: 複製人可呼吸，但可能帶有黏液肺病菌及刺激物。可除臭成氧氣與黏土，或在妥善防疫後供帕夫食用。

strategic_en: Renewable Water and Ice with Contaminated Oxygen alongside, a compact life-support resupply.
strategic_zh: 可再生的水與冰，並附帶污染氧，是精簡的生命維持補給點。
attention_en: All three phases appear; without a gas bay the Contaminated Oxygen share is lost.
attention_zh: 三種相態都會出現；沒有氣體貨艙就會失去污染氧的部分。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Bleach Stone, Rust, Uranium Ore and Sulfur.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含漂白石，鐵鏽，鈾礦和硫的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Feed a Rust Deoxidizer with salt to produce oxygen, chlorine and iron ore. The oxygen chain is finite unless rust is renewed through space or other sources.
outputs.use_zh: 與鹽一起供除鏽機，可產生氧氣、氯氣與鐵礦。除非由太空或其他來源補充，這條製氧鏈屬有限資源。

outputs.use_en: Fertilizes Grubfruit plants and feeds Sweetles/Grubgrubs, enabling sucrose and food production. Sulfur geysers can make this chain renewable.
outputs.use_zh: 可施肥蟲果並餵甜素甲蟲／蟲果蟲，支援蔗糖與食物生產；硫泉可使此鏈再生。

outputs.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
outputs.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

outputs.use_en: Enrich for Research Reactor fuel and radbolt production; Beetas can improve the refinement chain. Radiation, nuclear waste and reactor heat require shielding and automation.
outputs.use_zh: 可濃縮成研究反應爐燃料並產生輻射粒子；輻射蜂可改善精煉鏈。輻射、核廢料與反應爐熱需屏蔽及自動化。

strategic_en: Renewable Uranium Ore for Research Reactors and radbolt production, plus Sulfur for Sour Gas chains.
strategic_zh: 可再生的鈾礦供研究反應爐與輻射粒子生產，另有硫可用於酸性氣體產線。
attention_en: Capacity is only 5–10 t, the smallest of any POI, and the haul is radioactive; plan shielding and frequent trips.
attention_zh: 容量僅 5–10 公噸，是所有興趣點中最小的，且產物具放射性；請規劃屏蔽與頻繁往返。

pois.desc_en:
A cloud of resources containing Chlorine Gas, Uranium Ore and Carbon Dioxide.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含氯氣、鈾礦與二氧化碳的星雲。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

outputs.use_en: A cryogenic chlorine phase used mainly for storage or thermal designs before warming back into chlorine gas. It is extremely cold and phase changes can break pipes.
outputs.use_zh: 氯的低溫液相，主要用於儲存或熱力設計，升溫後會成氯氣。溫度極低，發生相變時可能損壞管線。

outputs.use_en: Enrich for Research Reactor fuel and radbolt production; Beetas can improve the refinement chain. Radiation, nuclear waste and reactor heat require shielding and automation.
outputs.use_zh: 可濃縮成研究反應爐燃料並產生輻射粒子；輻射蜂可改善精煉鏈。輻射、核廢料與反應爐熱需屏蔽及自動化。

strategic_en: The gas-phase Uranium Ore route, useful when a solid-only drill loadout is already committed elsewhere.
strategic_zh: 氣態版本的鈾礦路線；當固體貨艙配置已用於他處時特別有用。
attention_en: Capacity is only 5–10 t and nearly two thirds of the haul is Carbon Dioxide.
attention_zh: 容量僅 5–10 公噸，且將近三分之二的產物是二氧化碳。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Granite, Abyssalite, Sedimentary Rock, and Igneous Rock.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含花崗岩、深淵水晶、沉積岩與火成岩的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
outputs.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

outputs.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
outputs.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

outputs.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
outputs.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

outputs.use_en: Naturally insulates biome boundaries and normally cannot be used for construction. Extreme late-game melting can convert it toward tungsten, but ordinary mining destroys much of its value.
outputs.use_zh: 天然隔開生態區，通常不能作建材。極後期可用極端高溫熔融取得鎢鏈資源，但一般開採價值有限。

strategic_en: The largest capacity of any POI at 81–94 t, and the renewable Abyssalite source for insulated builds.
strategic_zh: 容量 81–94 公噸，是所有興趣點中最大的，也是隔熱建築所需的可再生深淵石來源。
attention_en: Pure bulk solids; value comes from volume rather than any single output.
attention_zh: 全為大宗固體；價值來自總量而非單一產物。

pois.desc_en:
A field of harvestable resources containing Salt Water,Brine and Carbon Dioxide.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
含有鹽水、濃鹽水與二氧化碳的可收穫資源區。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt and use directly for Waterweed or compatible Aquatic crops. Pumping and desalination add power and heat costs.
outputs.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽，也可直接供水草或相容水族作物；抽水與淡化會增加耗電及熱量。

outputs.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt; the water can support crops or electrolysis. Freezing separates useful temperature and phase-change opportunities.
outputs.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽；所得水可灌溉或電解製氧。其凝固與融化也能用於溫控與相變處理。

outputs.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

strategic_en: Bulk renewable Salt Water and Brine for desalination and Salt production.
strategic_zh: 大量可再生的鹽水與鹽滷，供脫鹽與製鹽使用。
attention_en: 90% of the haul is liquid; solid cargo capacity is nearly wasted here.
attention_zh: 產物有 90% 是液體；此處固體貨艙容量幾乎派不上用場。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Sandstone, Algae, Copper Ore and Sand.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含砂岩、藻類、銅礦與沙子的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
outputs.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

outputs.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
outputs.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

outputs.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
outputs.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

outputs.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
outputs.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

strategic_en: Renewable Sand for Water Sieves and Glass, with Algae and Cuprite alongside.
strategic_zh: 可再生的沙供淨水器與玻璃使用，另附藻類與赤銅礦。
attention_en: Sandstone is the largest share and has little use beyond construction.
attention_zh: 砂岩佔比最高，除建材外用途有限。

pois.desc_en:
Space junk from a forgotten age.

Collecting artifacts requires a rocket equipped with an Artifact Transport Module.
pois.desc_zh:
被遺忘時代的太空垃圾。

收集太空垃圾需要一艘裝備有文物運輸模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
outputs.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

outputs.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
outputs.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

outputs.use_en: (Cu) Molten Copper is a conductive Metal heated into a Liquid state.
outputs.use_zh: (Cu) 熔融銅是一種被加熱到液體狀態的導電金屬。

outputs.use_en: Glass is a brittle, transparent substance formed from Sand fired at high temperatures.
outputs.use_zh: 玻璃易碎、透光的物質，由沙子加熱至高溫製成。

strategic_en: Renewable Iron Ore, Copper and ready-made Glass, skipping the Glass Forge for Solar Panel builds.
strategic_zh: 可再生的鐵礦、銅與現成玻璃，建造太陽能板時可省去玻璃熔爐工序。
attention_en: Molten Copper arrives as a hot liquid and needs a liquid cargo bay.
attention_zh: 熔融銅以高溫液態產出，需要液體貨艙。

pois.desc_en:
An asteroid field containing Mud, Polluted Dirt and Cobalt Ore.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片包含泥土、汙土與鈷礦的小行星礦場。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Compost into dirt or feed Pokeshell-family critters; otherwise it off-gasses polluted oxygen. Store submerged or at sufficient gas pressure.
outputs.use_zh: 可堆肥成泥土，或餵拋殼蟹系生物；否則會逸散汙氧。宜浸液或存於足夠氣壓下。

outputs.use_en: Process in a Sludge Press into dirt and water, supporting farms and oxygen systems. Automation prevents duplicants from spending excessive labor on hauling.
outputs.use_zh: 可在污泥壓榨器分離成泥土與水，支援農業及製氧；自動化可減少複製人大量搬運時間。

outputs.use_en: Refine into cobalt for machinery and heat-transfer construction. Compare its temperature properties with aluminum before committing scarce ore.
outputs.use_zh: 可精煉成鈷，供機械與熱傳建築使用；消耗稀有礦石前應與鋁的溫度性能比較。

strategic_en: The renewable Cobaltite route for Cobalt refining and Shove Vole ranching feedstock.
strategic_zh: 可再生的鈷礦石路線，供鈷精煉與鏟地鼠牧場飼料使用。
attention_en: 70% of the haul is Toxic Sand, which offgasses Contaminated Oxygen when it warms; store it cold or vent it deliberately.
attention_zh: 產物有 70% 是毒沙，升溫時會逸出污染氧；請低溫儲存或有計畫地排放。

pois.desc_en:
The harvestable remains of a planet containing Zinc Ore, Siltstone, Coquina, Corallium, and Basalt.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片可收集的行星殘骸，含有鋅礦、粉砂岩、殼灰岩、紅珊瑚和玄武岩。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Aquatic metal ore for zinc production and related specialized machinery. Preserve it until the exact refined-metal demand of the colony is known.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的含鋅礦石，可生產鋅及相關特殊機械；在殖民地精煉金屬需求確定前宜保留。

outputs.use_en: Aquatic coral material used in specialized construction and processing chains. Treat deposits as finite until a renewable coral source is secured.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的珊瑚材料，可用於特殊建築與加工鏈；在建立可再生珊瑚來源前應視為有限資源。

outputs.use_en: General raw mineral for construction and thermal mass. It has no major advanced chain, making it a practical expendable building material.
outputs.use_zh: 一般建築與熱容量用原礦，沒有重要進階生產鏈，適合作可消耗建材。

outputs.use_en: A high-temperature raw mineral for construction and bulk thermal mass. Preserve better insulating materials for places where heat transfer matters.
outputs.use_zh: 耐高溫的建築原礦，可作大量熱容量材料；需要隔熱時應保留更合適的材料。

outputs.use_en: A shell-rich Aquatic raw mineral. Use it for construction or process it when lime-bearing material is needed for steel production.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的富含貝殼原礦；可作建材，或在製鋼需要含石灰材料時加工。

strategic_en: Renewable Corallium for Aquatic buildings and Zinc Ore for Zinc refining, without draining the asteroid's own reefs.
strategic_zh: 可再生的珊瑚石與鋅礦，供水生建築與鋅精煉使用，不必消耗星球本身的珊瑚礁。
attention_en: Coquina and Siltstone arrive as bulk filler; budget cargo capacity for the low-value majority.
attention_zh: 貝殼岩與粉砂岩屬於大宗填充物；規劃貨艙容量時要把低價值的大部分計算在內。

pois.desc_en:
The harvestable remains of a planet containing Zinc Ore, Silt Stone, Coquina, Corallium, and Basalt.

Space mining requires a rocket equipped with a Drillcone and a cargo module.
pois.desc_zh:
一片可開採的行星殘骸，含有鋅礦、粉砂岩、殼灰岩、紅珊瑚和玄武岩。

太空採礦需要一艘配備有鑽頭鼻錐和貨物模組的火箭。

outputs.use_en: Aquatic metal ore for zinc production and related specialized machinery. Preserve it until the exact refined-metal demand of the colony is known.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的含鋅礦石，可生產鋅及相關特殊機械；在殖民地精煉金屬需求確定前宜保留。

outputs.use_en: Aquatic coral material used in specialized construction and processing chains. Treat deposits as finite until a renewable coral source is secured.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的珊瑚材料，可用於特殊建築與加工鏈；在建立可再生珊瑚來源前應視為有限資源。

outputs.use_en: General raw mineral for construction and thermal mass. It has no major advanced chain, making it a practical expendable building material.
outputs.use_zh: 一般建築與熱容量用原礦，沒有重要進階生產鏈，適合作可消耗建材。

outputs.use_en: A high-temperature raw mineral for construction and bulk thermal mass. Preserve better insulating materials for places where heat transfer matters.
outputs.use_zh: 耐高溫的建築原礦，可作大量熱容量材料；需要隔熱時應保留更合適的材料。

outputs.use_en: A shell-rich Aquatic raw mineral. Use it for construction or process it when lime-bearing material is needed for steel production.
outputs.use_zh: 水族包的富含貝殼原礦；可作建材，或在製鋼需要含石灰材料時加工。

strategic_en: The planetary-mixing counterpart of the Aquatic ore field, and the only renewable Corallium route outside an Aquatic cluster.
strategic_zh: 水生礦場的行星混搭版本，也是水生星團以外唯一的可再生珊瑚石路線。
attention_en: Only generated when Aquatic Planet Pack planetary mixing is enabled at cluster setup.
attention_zh: 只有在建立星團時啟用水生行星包行星混搭才會生成。

pois.desc_en: A tear in space-time and the end-game destination of a Spaced Out cluster.
pois.desc_zh: 時空中的裂縫，是《眼冒金星！》星團的終局目的地。
strategic_en: The end-game objective: opening it requires the Temporal Tear Opener and completes the Spaced Out story.
strategic_zh: 終局目標：開啟需要時空裂縫開啟器，並完成《眼冒金星！》的劇情。
attention_en: Not harvestable and it yields no materials; it is a destination rather than a resource site.
attention_zh: 無法採集且不產出任何材料；這是目的地而非資源點。
